name: plinth
description: plinth and the third-party plugins it depends on, each pinned to a commit.

plugins.name: plinth
plugins.description: Skills: new-project, floor-check, template-update, arsenal, guide. Installs the default plugin set as dependencies. No hooks in the default set.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering skills, 15 of the 27 upstream ships: implement, TDD, code review, triage, grilling, domain modelling, bug diagnosis, planning (to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder), architecture clean-up, handoff, and a retrospective (retro, with writing-for-agents). No hooks; pinned here to a commit.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills-extra
plugins.description: The six Matt Pocock skills plinth lists but does not install: ask-matt, grill-with-docs, prototype, research, wizard and wait-what. Not installed by default (#520): moved here on #475's four criteria and their measured cost; no run compared a set with them and one without. The planning, clean-up and handoff five moved to mattpocock-skills (#704). No hooks; pinned to the same commit as mattpocock-skills.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: One taste-skill skill, design-taste-frontend: frontend design that does not look templated, for landing pages, portfolios and redesigns. No hooks; pinned here to a commit.

plugins.name: last30days
plugins.description: What people said about a topic in the last 30 days. For discovery, not for decisions. Not installed by default: about 90k tokens per call, and a SessionStart hook that checks its configuration.

plugins.name: ponytail-skills
plugins.description: One ponytail skill, /ponytail-audit, held on purpose at its pre-v5 version (pin 2ed6c52): a ranked, repository-wide list of over-engineering to delete, simplify or replace with the standard library or the platform; bugs, security and performance are out of its scope. ponytail v5 rewrote it into a full quality audit, which repeats the review step, so the pin is not raised (#715). Applies nothing; no hooks. Not installed by default (#598). The full ponytail plugin is below.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: The full ponytail plugin, hooks included. Not installed by default; for the opt-in hooks profile.
